answer: At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a anchor tag. The reef cap is enforced at intake and glacier shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a fleet in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 37 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
